game_title: Sentinel Loop – Ore Vein Depths Streak
game_concept: A rhythm puzzle set in Shadow Cave – Ore Vein Depths, a rich ore vein: the cave miner must handle shadow wraiths while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Sentinel Loop: Keep serving visitors while the input is not 'quit' and stop on the sentinel word.
theme: Shadow Cave – Ore Vein Depths: a rich ore vein
core_gameplay_loop: In Ore Vein Depths, repeat each round: Keep serving visitors while the input is not 'quit' and stop on the sentinel word. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the queue_length value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 7 consecutive correct decisions about queue_length to power up the cave miner and open the cave gate.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 4 (applied tier): Sentinel Loop
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how queue_length changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against shadow wraiths in Ore Vein Depths.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 7.
